name: American & European Home Care
summary: Honey-lemon, ginger chews, oatmeal baths and peppermint.

remedies.name: Warm Honey Lemon Water
remedies.howItHelps: Honey coats the throat and lemon brings vitamin C.
steps: Stir honey and lemon juice into warm water.

remedies.name: Ginger Chews
remedies.howItHelps: Ginger candies help settle motion sickness.
steps: Chew one ginger chew slowly during the ride.

remedies.name: Oatmeal Bath
remedies.howItHelps: Finely ground oats in a lukewarm bath calm itchy skin.
steps: Mix into a lukewarm bath and soak.

remedies.name: Peppermint Tea
steps: Steep peppermint leaves in hot water.
